name: Wartribe Alliances
source:
Welcome to Nubilia, a fantasy, medieval nation of nine city states! Our story takes place after the events of Wartribe Academy. Your father has asked you to investigate your mother's murder. He is certain, one of these families is at fault. After becoming familiar with the candidates that visited your academy, what you find is not what you expected from a roster of pretentious noble ladies. Mysteries unravel and allies become enemies in this erotic story of romance and danger. Protect the ones you love, if you think you can trust them...

[From [url=https://mister-rooster.itch.io/wartribe-alliances]Itch.io[/url]]
